summary: Shellshock. The probe is the standard defensive detection check administrators ran against their own bash: a crafted environment variable whose value is a function definition followed by a command. A vulnerable bash runs the trailing command while importing the function. The probe prints a marker and exits 0 only when that happens, so it confirms exposure without attacking anything external.
probe: env x='() { :;}; echo VULNERABLE' bash -c 'exit 0' | grep -q VULNERABLE
